verdict.rationale: Groq's core functionality is API-first and well documented. Chat completions, streaming, structured outputs, tool use, remote MCP, the Responses API, batch processing, service tiers and file uploads via the SDK are all exposed programmatically. Nothing shows that console/UI functions such as spend limits and budget alerts, LoRA adapter upload, or billing management can be done through the API, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented API parity for account/billing/spend-limit management, programmatic LoRA adapter upload, API key management via API, a published OpenAPI spec, independent confirmation of UI-to-API parity.
